brimEars.title: Brim ears
brimEars.intro: Round pads of brim under the corners keep them from lifting, with far less brim to clean off than a full brim.
brimEars.howTouch: Tap the model or the bed next to it to add an ear. Tap an ear to pick it, then Remove picked.
brimEars.howMouse: Click the model or the bed next to it to add an ear. Click an ear to pick it (Shift adds more), or right-click it to remove it.
brimEars.notPainted: The ears only print when this object's brim type is Painted (brim ears).
brimEars.usePainted: Use brim ears for this object
brimEars.maxAngleTip: Corners sharper than this get an ear
brimEars.detectionTip: Small bumps shorter than this are smoothed out first, so they don't get ears
